text: Laana kan no dogina yimɓe e kala ko woni e makka e nder mollooɗe mawnuɗe waaɗe wa pelle. Sabu yurmeende baaba nden, Nuuhu noddi ɓiɗɗo makko yeddunooɗo on, hari on selindii e ben-mun e yimɓe mun: Ko an yo ɓinngel am, waɗɗida e amen ka laana fii yo a daɗu yoolagol, wata a wonndu e yedduɓe ɓen haa halkide-ɗaa e maɓɓe yoolagol.
